For media

For media

ANU Media is here to help connect you with stories and experts.

ANU Media manages the University’s day-to-day media operations and is the first point of contact for all media enquiries about the University and its core operations and ANU Reporter. 

Contact the team for media queries about ANU, timely research stories and expert analysis, or for help tracking down suitable experts that aren’t listed in our Experts guide. 

We can also connect TV and radio broadcasters with experts via the ANU studio.

Media wanting to take photos or video on the ANU campus should also contact ANU Media in the first instance.
